title: Cilantro Yogurt Chicken
description: Cilantro Yogurt Chicken is a Continental-inspired modern fusion dish featuring tender chicken marinated in Greek yogurt, fresh cilantro, garlic, and aromatic spices. Finished with a refreshing cilantro yogurt sauce, it is a light, flavorful, and elegant main course.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Marinade
items: Boneless chicken thighs or breasts, trimmed – 600 g

ingredients.title: For the Cilantro Yogurt Sauce
items: Sugar – a pinch (optional, to balance acidity)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinate the Chicken
steps: In a large bowl, combine yogurt, cilantro, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, paprika, cumin, pepper, salt, and olive oil.
Coat the chicken evenly with the marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for 2–4 hours, ideally overnight for maximum flavor.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Cook the Chicken
steps: Option 1: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Place marinated chicken on a lined baking tray. Roast for 20–25 minutes until cooked through and slightly golden. Optional: Broil for 2–3 minutes for a crispy top.
Option 2: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare the Cilantro Yogurt Sauce
steps: Mix Greek yogurt, chopped cilantro, lemon juice, salt, and a pinch of sugar.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Plating
steps: Drizzle a thin layer of cilantro yogurt sauce on the plate.
Garnish with microgreens or cilantro sprigs and lemon wedges.
Serve with roasted vegetables, quinoa, or a light salad for a continental touch.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with roasted vegetables, quinoa, or a fresh green salad.
Pair with buttered baby potatoes or herb rice.
Garnish with fresh cilantro sprigs and lemon wedges before serving.

chefTips: Marinate the chicken overnight for deeper flavor and tenderness.
Use thick Greek yogurt to prevent the marinade from becoming runny.
Add half the cilantro to the marinade and the remaining half fresh in the sauce for a vibrant herbaceous note.
Slice the chicken at an angle and drizzle the sauce artistically for a fine-dining presentation.
For a modern European twist, add a subtle hint of truffle oil or smoked paprika.
